text: That diagnosis is inconsistent with the skin lesions you described. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum. The clinical presentation of pearly papules with central umbilication, combined with the history of daycare exposure and sibling with chickenpox (indicating susceptibility to other viruses), confirms this viral skin infection. The normal CBC and ESR rule out significant bacterial infection or systemic inflammation.
